items.title: A.J. Brown: Unlikely for Week 12, per Vrabel
items.text:
Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said that he doesn't anticipate Brown (hamstring) playing Sunday against the Chargers, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Will have actions reviewed
items.text:
Metcalf will have his actions from Sunday's game against the Eagles reviewed "for potential additional discipline, including a suspension," Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Sustains fourth-quarter injury Sunday
items.text:
Tuten (undisclosed) exited Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants after an eight-yard gain with 3:40 left in the contest, Garry Smits
of the Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Five touches in Week 11
items.text:
Samuel logged two carries for 27 yards, gathered in three of four targets for 20 yards and returned two kickoffs for 57 yards during Sunday's 35-10 win against the Vikings in Mexico City.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Mason: Team's leading rusher in lopsided loss
items.text:
Mason rushed 11 times for 38 yards while catching his lone target for minus-1 yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
